title: 6 Regina St N and 24, 28, 34 Erb St E (OPA-41, Z-22-12)
body:
Application to amend zoning for 6 Regina Street North and 24, 28, 34 Erb St East
Changes to the Official Plan and the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
VanLegend Regina LP is applying to allow an 18-storey mixed-use building containing a mix of residential, office space, commercial space and parking.
Official plan changes requested include:
re-designating a portion of the lands (6 Regina St. N.) from Medium Density-20 metres to High Density-81 m
establishing specific provision area policies to limit the maximum building height on different areas of the site as either 4 storeys or 18 storeys
Refer to page 7 of the Planning Justification Report to identify the specific areas and building heights.
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
increasing the maximum density to permit 245 bedrooms from 135 bedrooms
limiting building height to 18 storeys in one area of the site and 4 storeys in another area
reducing the rear yard setbacks to 0.44 m from 4.5 m
reducing the tower separation to 5.67 m from 11 m
increasing the horizontal tower dimension to 53.2 m from 40 m
permitting the tower stepback above the podium on the Erb St. building façade to be measured excluding balconies instead of including balconies
not requiring a common outdoor area
reducing the required parking from 187 parking spaces to 122 parking spaces as part of a shared parking system
allowing a portion of the structured parking to not be located behind the building floor area along a portion of the Erb Street façade
Refer to page 7 of the Planning Justification Report to identify the specific areas and building heights.
View the documents submitted by the development company under Supporting Documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Tallest tower: 18 storeys depending on what is permitted
Number of units: 218
Unit sizes: 164 units with one bedroom, 27 units with one bedroom plus den, 27 units with two bedrooms
Housing types: apartments
Non-residential floor space
Office space: 1860 square m
Commercial space: 503 square m
Parking
Parking: 122 spaces as part of a shared parking system at grade or higher
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the Planning Department.
